title: Personal Loans Payment History and the Credit Builder AutoPay Due Day
content:
When AutoPay is turned on again on a Credit Builder account, days are added to the account's current due day when the borrower's Larkspur personal loans show recent payment trouble. The facts are read from the ledger of the borrower's Personal Loans: its returned-payment entries and late-fee entries, by their dates.

## Clause

When a payment on any of the borrower's Larkspur personal loans was returned in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a line dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the loan-return buffer is added; when none was returned but a personal-loan late fee was charged in those months, the loan-late buffer; otherwise no loan buffer.

| Borrower's Personal Loans in the 12 months | Days added to the due day |
|---|---|
| a payment returned | loan-return buffer: 2 days |
| no payment returned, but a late fee charged | loan-late buffer: 1 day |
| neither, or no personal loan | none |

## Dates on the boundary (hypothetical)

Today 18 January: a personal-loan return dated 18 January of the previous year falls outside the 12 months; a personal-loan late fee dated 19 January of the previous year is counted.
